```java
/**
 * IMMUTABLE VEHICLE CLASS: Thread-safe vehicle representation
 */
public class Vehicle {
    private final String licensePlate;
    private final VehicleType type;
    private final String ownerName;
    private final String phoneNumber;
    private final boolean isElectric;
    private final boolean needsHandicapAccess;
    
    public Vehicle(String licensePlate, VehicleType type, String ownerName, 
                  String phoneNumber, boolean isElectric, boolean needsHandicapAccess) {
        // Input validation
        if (licensePlate == null || licensePlate.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("License plate cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (type == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Vehicle type cannot be null");
        }
        if (ownerName == null || ownerName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Owner name cannot be null or empty");
        }
        
        this.licensePlate = licensePlate.trim().toUpperCase();
        this.type = type;
        this.ownerName = ownerName.trim();
        this.phoneNumber = phoneNumber != null ? phoneNumber.trim() : null;
        this.isElectric = isElectric;
        this.needsHandicapAccess = needsHandicapAccess;
    }
    
    // Getters only (immutable)
    public String getLicensePlate() { return licensePlate; }
    public VehicleType getType() { return type; }
    public String getOwnerName() { return ownerName; }
    public String getPhoneNumber() { return phoneNumber; }
    public boolean isElectric() { return isElectric; }
    public boolean needsHandicapAccess() { return needsHandicapAccess; }
    
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
        if (this == obj) return true;
        if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
        Vehicle vehicle = (Vehicle) obj;
        return licensePlate.equals(vehicle.licensePlate);
    }
    
    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return licensePlate.hashCode();
    }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("Vehicle{licensePlate='%s', type=%s, owner='%s', electric=%s, handicap=%s}",
                           licensePlate, type, ownerName, isElectric, needsHandicapAccess);
    }
}

/**
 * THREAD-SAFE PARKING SPOT: Handles concurrent access safely
 */
public class ParkingSpot {
    private final String spotId;
    private final SpotType type;
    private final int level;
    private final String zone;
    private final boolean hasChargingStation;
    
    // Mutable state protected by locks
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
    private volatile ParkingStatus status;
    private Vehicle parkedVehicle;
    private LocalDateTime occupiedSince;
    private LocalDateTime reservedUntil;
    private String reservationId;
    
    public ParkingSpot(String spotId, SpotType type, int level, String zone, boolean hasChargingStation) {
        if (spotId == null || spotId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Spot ID cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (type == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Spot type cannot be null");
        }
        
        this.spotId = spotId.trim();
        this.type = type;
        this.level = level;
        this.zone = zone != null ? zone.trim() : "DEFAULT";
        this.hasChargingStation = hasChargingStation;
        this.status = ParkingStatus.AVAILABLE;
    }
    
    /**
     * THREAD-SAFE PARKING: Atomic operation with validation
     */
    public ParkingResult parkVehicle(Vehicle vehicle) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            // Validate current state
            if (status != ParkingStatus.AVAILABLE) {
                return ParkingResult.failure("Spot is not available (Status: " + status + ")");
            }
            
            // Validate vehicle compatibility
            if (!canAccommodateVehicle(vehicle)) {
                return ParkingResult.failure("Vehicle type " + vehicle.getType() + 
                                           " cannot fit in " + type + " spot");
            }
            
            // Special requirements validation
            if (vehicle.isElectric() && !hasChargingStation && type == SpotType.ELECTRIC) {
                return ParkingResult.failure("Electric vehicle requires charging station");
            }
            
            if (vehicle.needsHandicapAccess() && type != SpotType.HANDICAPPED) {
                return ParkingResult.failure("Vehicle requires handicap accessible spot");
            }
            
            // Park the vehicle
            this.parkedVehicle = vehicle;
            this.occupiedSince = LocalDateTime.now();
            this.status = ParkingStatus.OCCUPIED;
            this.reservationId = null; // Clear any reservation
            this.reservedUntil = null;
            
            return ParkingResult.success("Vehicle parked successfully in spot " + spotId);
            
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * THREAD-SAFE VEHICLE REMOVAL: Returns parking session info
     */
    public ParkingSession removeVehicle() {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            if (status != ParkingStatus.OCCUPIED || parkedVehicle == null) {
                return null; // No vehicle to remove
            }
            
            // Create parking session record
            ParkingSession session = new ParkingSession(
                spotId,
                parkedVehicle,
                occupiedSince,
                LocalDateTime.now(),
                type.getBaseHourlyRate()
            );
            
            // Clear spot
            this.parkedVehicle = null;
            this.occupiedSince = null;
            this.status = ParkingStatus.AVAILABLE;
            
            return session;
            
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * VEHICLE COMPATIBILITY CHECK: Business logic for spot assignment
     */
    public boolean canAccommodateVehicle(Vehicle vehicle) {
        // Basic size check
        if (!type.canAccommodate(vehicle.getType())) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Electric vehicle special handling
        if (vehicle.isElectric()) {
            // Electric vehicles can use electric spots or regular spots
            return type == SpotType.ELECTRIC || 
                   (type.canAccommodate(vehicle.getType()) && hasChargingStation);
        }
        
        // Handicap accessibility
        if (vehicle.needsHandicapAccess()) {
            return type == SpotType.HANDICAPPED;
        }
        
        // Regular vehicles cannot use handicap spots
        if (type == SpotType.HANDICAPPED) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    // Thread-safe getters
    public String getSpotId() { return spotId; }
    public SpotType getType() { return type; }
    public int getLevel() { return level; }
    public String getZone() { return zone; }
    public boolean hasChargingStation() { return hasChargingStation; }
    
    public ParkingStatus getStatus() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return status;
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return String.format("ParkingSpot{id='%s', type=%s, level=%d, zone='%s', status=%s, charging=%s}",
                               spotId, type, level, zone, status, hasChargingStation);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }
}

/**
 * PARKING SESSION: Immutable record of parking transaction
 */
public class ParkingSession {
    private final String spotId;
    private final Vehicle vehicle;
    private final LocalDateTime startTime;
    private final LocalDateTime endTime;
    private final Duration duration;
    private final BigDecimal hourlyRate;
    private final BigDecimal totalCost;
    
    public ParkingSession(String spotId, Vehicle vehicle, LocalDateTime startTime, 
                         LocalDateTime endTime, BigDecimal hourlyRate) {
        this.spotId = spotId;
        this.vehicle = vehicle;
        this.startTime = startTime;
        this.endTime = endTime;
        this.duration = Duration.between(startTime, endTime);
        this.hourlyRate = hourlyRate;
        this.totalCost = calculateCost();
    }
    
    private BigDecimal calculateCost() {
        // Calculate cost with minimum 1-hour charge
        long minutes = duration.toMinutes();
        double hours = Math.max(1.0, Math.ceil(minutes / 60.0));
        return hourlyRate.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(hours));
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getSpotId() { return spotId; }
    public Vehicle getVehicle() { return vehicle; }
    public LocalDateTime getStartTime() { return startTime; }
    public LocalDateTime getEndTime() { return endTime; }
    public Duration getDuration() { return duration; }
    public BigDecimal getHourlyRate() { return hourlyRate; }
    public BigDecimal getTotalCost() { return totalCost; }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("ParkingSession{spot='%s', vehicle='%s', duration=%d min, cost=$%.2f}",
                           spotId, vehicle.getLicensePlate(), duration.toMinutes(), totalCost);
    }
}

/**
 * PARKING RESULT: Type-safe operation results
 */
public class ParkingResult {
    private final boolean success;
    private final String message;
    private final LocalDateTime timestamp;
    
    private ParkingResult(boolean success, String message) {
        this.success = success;
        this.message = message;
        this.timestamp = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
    
    public static ParkingResult success(String message) {
        return new ParkingResult(true, message);
    }
    
    public static ParkingResult failure(String message) {
        return new ParkingResult(false, message);
    }
    
    public boolean isSuccess() { return success; }
    public String getMessage() { return message; }
    public LocalDateTime getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("ParkingResult{success=%s, message='%s', time=%s}",
                           success, message, timestamp);
    }
}

/**
 * SMART PARKING LOT: Enterprise-grade parking management system
 * Features: Real-time tracking, optimization, reservations, analytics
 */
public class SmartParkingLot {
    private final String lotId;
    private final String name;
    private final String address;
    private final int totalLevels;
    
    // Thread-safe collections for concurrent access
    private final Map<String, ParkingSpot> spots;
    private final Map<String, Vehicle> parkedVehicles; // licensePlate -> Vehicle
    private final Map<String, String> vehicleToSpot;   // licensePlate -> spotId
    private final List<ParkingSession> sessionHistory;
    
    // Real-time statistics (thread-safe)
    private volatile int totalSpots;
    private volatile int occupiedSpots;
    
    public SmartParkingLot(String lotId, String name, String address, int totalLevels) {
        if (lotId == null || lotId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Lot ID cannot be null or empty");
        }
        
        this.lotId = lotId.trim();
        this.name = name != null ? name.trim() : "Unnamed Parking Lot";
        this.address = address != null ? address.trim() : "Unknown Address";
        this.totalLevels = Math.max(1, totalLevels);
        
        // Initialize thread-safe collections
        this.spots = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.parkedVehicles = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.vehicleToSpot = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.sessionHistory = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
        
        // Initialize counters
        this.totalSpots = 0;
        this.occupiedSpots = 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * ADD PARKING SPOT: Dynamic spot addition
     */
    public boolean addParkingSpot(ParkingSpot spot) {
        if (spot == null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        String spotId = spot.getSpotId();
        if (spots.containsKey(spotId)) {
            return false; // Spot already exists
        }
        
        spots.put(spotId, spot);
        totalSpots++;
        
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * SMART PARKING: Finds optimal spot using business rules
     */
    public ParkingResult parkVehicle(Vehicle vehicle) {
        if (vehicle == null) {
            return ParkingResult.failure("Vehicle cannot be null");
        }
        
        String licensePlate = vehicle.getLicensePlate();
        
        // Check if vehicle is already parked
        if (parkedVehicles.containsKey(licensePlate)) {
            return ParkingResult.failure("Vehicle " + licensePlate + " is already parked");
        }
        
        // Find optimal parking spot
        ParkingSpot optimalSpot = findOptimalSpot(vehicle);
        if (optimalSpot == null) {
            return ParkingResult.failure("No suitable parking spot available for " + vehicle.getType());
        }
        
        // Attempt to park
        ParkingResult result = optimalSpot.parkVehicle(vehicle);
        if (result.isSuccess()) {
            // Update tracking collections
            parkedVehicles.put(licensePlate, vehicle);
            vehicleToSpot.put(licensePlate, optimalSpot.getSpotId());
            occupiedSpots++;
            
            return ParkingResult.success(String.format("Vehicle %s parked in spot %s (Level %d, Zone %s)",
                                                     licensePlate, optimalSpot.getSpotId(), 
                                                     optimalSpot.getLevel(), optimalSpot.getZone()));
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    /**
     * OPTIMAL SPOT FINDER: Advanced algorithm for spot selection
     */
    private ParkingSpot findOptimalSpot(Vehicle vehicle) {
        List<ParkingSpot> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
        
        // Find all compatible spots
        for (ParkingSpot spot : spots.values()) {
            if (spot.getStatus() == ParkingStatus.AVAILABLE && spot.canAccommodateVehicle(vehicle)) {
                candidates.add(spot);
            }
        }
        
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Apply optimization rules
        
        // Rule 1: Handicap vehicles get handicap spots first
        if (vehicle.needsHandicapAccess()) {
            Optional<ParkingSpot> handicapSpot = candidates.stream()
                .filter(spot -> spot.getType() == SpotType.HANDICAPPED)
                .findFirst();
            if (handicapSpot.isPresent()) {
                return handicapSpot.get();
            }
        }
        
        // Rule 2: Electric vehicles prefer electric spots
        if (vehicle.isElectric()) {
            Optional<ParkingSpot> electricSpot = candidates.stream()
                .filter(spot -> spot.getType() == SpotType.ELECTRIC && spot.hasChargingStation())
                .findFirst();
            if (electricSpot.isPresent()) {
                return electricSpot.get();
            }
        }
        
        // Rule 3: Size efficiency - prefer smallest suitable spot
        candidates.sort((a, b) -> {
            int sizeA = a.getType().getCapacity();
            int sizeB = b.getType().getCapacity();
            int vehicleSize = vehicle.getType().getSizeRequirement();
            
            // Prefer exact size match
            boolean exactMatchA = sizeA == vehicleSize;
            boolean exactMatchB = sizeB == vehicleSize;
            
            if (exactMatchA && !exactMatchB) return -1;
            if (!exactMatchA && exactMatchB) return 1;
            
            // Prefer smaller spots (more efficient)
            if (sizeA != sizeB) return Integer.compare(sizeA, sizeB);
            
            // Prefer lower levels (easier access)
            return Integer.compare(a.getLevel(), b.getLevel());
        });
        
        return candidates.get(0);
    }
    
    /**
     * VEHICLE REMOVAL: Complete checkout process
     */
    public ParkingSession removeVehicle(String licensePlate) {
        if (licensePlate == null || licensePlate.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        
        String normalizedPlate = licensePlate.trim().toUpperCase();
        
        if (!parkedVehicles.containsKey(normalizedPlate)) {
            return null; // Vehicle not found
        }
        
        String spotId = vehicleToSpot.get(normalizedPlate);
        ParkingSpot spot = spots.get(spotId);
        
        if (spot == null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        ParkingSession session = spot.removeVehicle();
        if (session != null) {
            parkedVehicles.remove(normalizedPlate);
            vehicleToSpot.remove(normalizedPlate);
            occupiedSpots--;
            sessionHistory.add(session);
        }
        
        return session;
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getLotId() { return lotId; }
    public String getName() { return name; }
    public int getTotalSpots() { return totalSpots; }
    public int getOccupiedSpots() { return occupiedSpots; }
    public int getAvailableSpots() { return totalSpots - occupiedSpots; }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("SmartParkingLot{id='%s', name='%s', spots=%d/%d occupied}",
                           lotId, name, occupiedSpots, totalSpots);
    }
}
```

### Complexity Analysis

**Time Complexity**:
- **Spot Addition**: O(1) - hash map insertion
- **Vehicle Parking**: O(n) - where n is available spots (optimized with sorting)
- **Vehicle Removal**: O(1) - direct hash map lookup
- **Optimal Spot Finding**: O(n log n) - sorting candidates

**Space Complexity**:
- **Parking Lot Storage**: O(n) - where n is total spots
- **Session History**: O(m) - where m is completed sessions
- **Thread Safety**: O(1) - fixed overhead per spot

public class ParkingLot {
    private String name;
    private List<ParkingSpot> spots;
    private Map<String, ParkingTicket> activeTickets;
    
    public ParkingLot(String name) {
        this.name = name;
        this.spots = new ArrayList<>();
        this.activeTickets = new HashMap<>();
    }
    
    public ParkingTicket parkVehicle(Vehicle vehicle) {
        for (ParkingSpot spot : spots) {
            if (spot.canFitVehicle(vehicle)) {
                if (spot.parkVehicle(vehicle)) {
                    ParkingTicket ticket = new ParkingTicket(vehicle, spot);
                    activeTickets.put(ticket.getTicketId(), ticket);
                    return ticket;
                }
            }
        }
        return null; // No available spots
    }
    
    public double exitVehicle(String ticketId) {
        ParkingTicket ticket = activeTickets.remove(ticketId);
        if (ticket != null) {
            ticket.getSpot().removeVehicle();
            return ticket.calculateFee();
        }
        return 0.0;
    }
}

```java
public class BasicLibrary {
```

```java
public class Book {
    private String isbn;
    private String title;
    private String author;
    private boolean isAvailable;
    private LocalDate dueDate;
    
    public Book(String isbn, String title, String author) {
        this.isbn = isbn;
        this.title = title;
        this.author = author;
        this.isAvailable = true;
    }
    
    public boolean checkOut(int loanPeriodDays) {
        if (isAvailable) {
            isAvailable = false;
            dueDate = LocalDate.now().plusDays(loanPeriodDays);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public void returnBook() {
        isAvailable = true;
        dueDate = null;
    }
    
    public boolean isOverdue() {
        return dueDate != null && LocalDate.now().isAfter(dueDate);
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getIsbn() { return isbn; }
    public String getTitle() { return title; }
    public String getAuthor() { return author; }
    public boolean isAvailable() { return isAvailable; }
    public LocalDate getDueDate() { return dueDate; }
}

public class Member {
    private String memberId;
    private String name;
    private String email;
    private List<Book> borrowedBooks;
    private double fines;
    
    public Member(String memberId, String name, String email) {
        this.memberId = memberId;
        this.name = name;
        this.email = email;
        this.borrowedBooks = new ArrayList<>();
        this.fines = 0.0;
    }
    
    public boolean canBorrowBook() {
        return borrowedBooks.size() < 5 && fines < 10.0; // Max 5 books, max $10 fines
    }
    
    public void borrowBook(Book book) {
        if (canBorrowBook() && book.checkOut(14)) { // 14-day loan
            borrowedBooks.add(book);
        }
    }
    
    public void returnBook(Book book) {
        if (borrowedBooks.remove(book)) {
            if (book.isOverdue()) {
                long daysOverdue = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(book.getDueDate(), LocalDate.now());
                fines += daysOverdue * 0.50; // $0.50 per day
            }
            book.returnBook();
        }
    }
    
    public void payFine(double amount) {
        fines = Math.max(0, fines - amount);
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getMemberId() { return memberId; }
    public String getName() { return name; }
    public List<Book> getBorrowedBooks() { return new ArrayList<>(borrowedBooks); }
    public double getFines() { return fines; }
}

public class Library {
    private String name;
    private Map<String, Book> books; // ISBN -> Book
    private Map<String, Member> members; // MemberID -> Member
    
    public Library(String name) {
        this.name = name;
        this.books = new HashMap<>();
        this.members = new HashMap<>();
    }
    
    public void addBook(Book book) {
        books.put(book.getIsbn(), book);
    }
    
    public void registerMember(Member member) {
        members.put(member.getMemberId(), member);
    }
    
    public boolean borrowBook(String memberId, String isbn) {
        Member member = members.get(memberId);
        Book book = books.get(isbn);
        
        if (member != null && book != null && member.canBorrowBook() && book.isAvailable()) {
            member.borrowBook(book);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public boolean returnBook(String memberId, String isbn) {
        Member member = members.get(memberId);
        Book book = books.get(isbn);
        
        if (member != null && book != null) {
            member.returnBook(book);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public List<Book> searchBooks(String query) {
        return books.values().stream()
                   .filter(book -> book.getTitle().toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase()) ||
                                 book.getAuthor().toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase()))
                   .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}
```

### Advanced Questions (Hard)

#### Q6: Design a thread-safe singleton with lazy initialization
**Companies**: Google, Meta, Microsoft  
**Difficulty**: Hard  
**Category**: Design Patterns

**Question**: Implement a thread-safe singleton pattern with lazy initialization. Explain the trade-offs of different approaches.

**Solution**:

**Approach 1: Double-Checked Locking**
```java
public class DatabaseConnection {
    private static volatile DatabaseConnection instance;
    private Connection connection;
    
    private DatabaseConnection() {
        // Initialize database connection
        this.connection = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:...");
    }
    
    public static DatabaseConnection getInstance() {
        if (instance == null) {
            synchronized (DatabaseConnection.class) {
                if (instance == null) {
                    instance = new DatabaseConnection();
                }
            }
        }
        return instance;
    }
    
    public Connection getConnection() {
        return connection;
    }
}
```

**Approach 2: Initialization-on-demand holder**
```java
public class DatabaseConnection {
    private Connection connection;
    
    private DatabaseConnection() {
        this.connection = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:...");
    }
    
    private static class Holder {
        private static final DatabaseConnection INSTANCE = new DatabaseConnection();
    }
    
    public static DatabaseConnection getInstance() {
        return Holder.INSTANCE;
    }
}
```

**Approach 3: Enum Singleton**
```java
public enum DatabaseConnection {
    INSTANCE;
    
    private Connection connection;
    
    DatabaseConnection() {
        this.connection = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:...");
    }
    
    public Connection getConnection() {
        return connection;
    }
}
```

**Trade-offs**:
- **Double-checked locking**: Complex but allows lazy initialization
- **Holder pattern**: Simple, thread-safe, lazy initialization
- **Enum**: Simplest, handles serialization automatically, but not lazy

#### Q7: Implement the Observer pattern for a stock trading system
**Companies**: Google, Amazon, Meta  
**Difficulty**: Hard  
**Category**: Design Patterns

**Question**: Design a stock trading system where multiple traders can observe price changes of stocks. Implement the Observer pattern with thread safety.

**Solution**:
```java
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

public interface StockObserver {
    void onPriceChanged(Stock stock, double oldPrice, double newPrice);
    void onVolumeChanged(Stock stock, long oldVolume, long newVolume);
}

public class Stock {
    private final String symbol;
    private volatile double price;
    private volatile long volume;
    private final List<StockObserver> observers;
    private final Object lock = new Object();
    
    public Stock(String symbol, double initialPrice) {
        this.symbol = symbol;
        this.price = initialPrice;
        this.volume = 0;
        this.observers = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>(); // Thread-safe
    }
    
    public void addObserver(StockObserver observer) {
        observers.add(observer);
    }
    
    public void removeObserver(StockObserver observer) {
        observers.remove(observer);
    }
    
    public void setPrice(double newPrice) {
        double oldPrice;
        synchronized (lock) {
            oldPrice = this.price;
            this.price = newPrice;
        }
        notifyPriceChange(oldPrice, newPrice);
    }
    
    public void addVolume(long additionalVolume) {
        long oldVolume;
        synchronized (lock) {
            oldVolume = this.volume;
            this.volume += additionalVolume;
        }
        notifyVolumeChange(oldVolume, this.volume);
    }
    
    private void notifyPriceChange(double oldPrice, double newPrice) {
        for (StockObserver observer : observers) {
            try {
                observer.onPriceChanged(this, oldPrice, newPrice);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.err.println("Error notifying observer: " + e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
    
    private void notifyVolumeChange(long oldVolume, long newVolume) {
        for (StockObserver observer : observers) {
            try {
                observer.onVolumeChanged(this, oldVolume, newVolume);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.err.println("Error notifying observer: " + e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
    
    public String getSymbol() { return symbol; }
    public double getPrice() { return price; }
    public long getVolume() { return volume; }
}

public class Trader implements StockObserver {
    private final String name;
    private final Map<String, Integer> portfolio; // symbol -> shares
    private double cashBalance;
    
    public Trader(String name, double initialCash) {
        this.name = name;
        this.cashBalance = initialCash;
        this.portfolio = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    }
    
    @Override
    public void onPriceChanged(Stock stock, double oldPrice, double newPrice) {
        double changePercent = ((newPrice - oldPrice) / oldPrice) * 100;
        
        if (changePercent > 5.0) {
            // Price increased by more than 5% - consider selling
            sellStock(stock, calculateSellQuantity(stock));
        } else if (changePercent < -5.0) {
            // Price decreased by more than 5% - consider buying
            buyStock(stock, calculateBuyQuantity(stock, newPrice));
        }
        
        System.out.printf("Trader %s: %s price changed from $%.2f to $%.2f (%.2f%%)%n",
            name, stock.getSymbol(), oldPrice, newPrice, changePercent);
    }
    
    @Override
    public void onVolumeChanged(Stock stock, long oldVolume, long newVolume) {
        if (newVolume > oldVolume * 2) {
            System.out.printf("Trader %s: High volume alert for %s (Volume: %d)%n",
                name, stock.getSymbol(), newVolume);
        }
    }
    
    private void buyStock(Stock stock, int quantity) {
        double cost = stock.getPrice() * quantity;
        if (cashBalance >= cost && quantity > 0) {
            cashBalance -= cost;
            portfolio.merge(stock.getSymbol(), quantity, Integer::sum);
            System.out.printf("Trader %s bought %d shares of %s at $%.2f%n",
                name, quantity, stock.getSymbol(), stock.getPrice());
        }
    }
    
    private void sellStock(Stock stock, int quantity) {
        int currentShares = portfolio.getOrDefault(stock.getSymbol(), 0);
        int sharesToSell = Math.min(quantity, currentShares);
        
        if (sharesToSell > 0) {
            double proceeds = stock.getPrice() * sharesToSell;
            cashBalance += proceeds;
            portfolio.put(stock.getSymbol(), currentShares - sharesToSell);
            System.out.printf("Trader %s sold %d shares of %s at $%.2f%n",
                name, sharesToSell, stock.getSymbol(), stock.getPrice());
        }
    }
    
    private int calculateBuyQuantity(Stock stock, double price) {
        // Buy up to 10% of cash balance
        double maxSpend = cashBalance * 0.1;
        return (int) (maxSpend / price);
    }
    
    private int calculateSellQuantity(Stock stock) {
        // Sell 50% of holdings
        int currentShares = portfolio.getOrDefault(stock.getSymbol(), 0);
        return currentShares / 2;
    }
    
    public double getPortfolioValue(Map<String, Stock> stocks) {
        double totalValue = cashBalance;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> holding : portfolio.entrySet()) {
            Stock stock = stocks.get(holding.getKey());
            if (stock != null) {
                totalValue += stock.getPrice() * holding.getValue();
            }
        }
        return totalValue;
    }
}
```

#### Q8: Implement a generic object pool
**Companies**: Google, Amazon, Microsoft  
**Difficulty**: Hard  
**Category**: Memory Management

**Question**: Implement a thread-safe generic object pool that can work with any type of object. Include features like maximum pool size, object validation, and automatic cleanup.

**Solution**:
```java
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import java.util.function.Predicate;

public class ObjectPool<T> {
    private final BlockingQueue<T> pool;
    private final Supplier<T> factory;
    private final Predicate<T> validator;
    private final int maxSize;
    private final AtomicInteger createdCount;
    private final ScheduledExecutorService cleanupExecutor;
    
    public ObjectPool(Supplier<T> factory, int maxSize) {
        this(factory, maxSize, obj -> true); // Default validator always returns true
    }
    
    public ObjectPool(Supplier<T> factory, int maxSize, Predicate<T> validator) {
        this.factory = factory;
        this.maxSize = maxSize;
        this.validator = validator;
        this.pool = new LinkedBlockingQueue<>(maxSize);
        this.createdCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
        this.cleanupExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r -> {
            Thread t = new Thread(r, "ObjectPool-Cleanup");
            t.setDaemon(true);
            return t;
        });
        
        // Schedule periodic cleanup
        cleanupExecutor.scheduleAtFixedRate(this::cleanup, 60, 60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    }
    
    public T acquire() throws InterruptedException {
        T object = pool.poll();
        if (object == null) {
            object = factory.get();
            createdCount.incrementAndGet();
        }
        
        // Validate object before returning
        if (!validator.test(object)) {
            // Object is invalid, try to get another one
            return acquire();
        }
        
        return object;
    }
    
    public T acquire(long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException {
        T object = pool.poll(timeout, unit);
        if (object == null) {
            object = factory.get();
            createdCount.incrementAndGet();
        }
        
        if (!validator.test(object)) {
            return acquire(timeout, unit);
        }
        
        return object;
    }
    
    public void release(T object) {
        if (object != null && validator.test(object)) {
            // Reset object if it implements Resetable
            if (object instanceof Resetable) {
                ((Resetable) object).reset();
            }
            
            // Only add back to pool if there's space
            pool.offer(object);
        }
    }
    
    private void cleanup() {
        // Remove invalid objects from pool
        pool.removeIf(obj -> !validator.test(obj));
    }
    
    public int getPoolSize() {
        return pool.size();
    }
    
    public int getCreatedCount() {
        return createdCount.get();
    }
    
    public void shutdown() {
        cleanupExecutor.shutdown();
        pool.clear();
    }
    
    // Interface for objects that can be reset
    public interface Resetable {
        void reset();
    }
}

// Example usage with StringBuilder
class StringBuilderPool {
    private static final ObjectPool<StringBuilder> POOL = new ObjectPool<>(
        () -> new StringBuilder(256),
        20,
        sb -> sb.length() < 1024 // Don't reuse if too large
    );
    
    public static StringBuilder acquire() throws InterruptedException {
        return POOL.acquire();
    }
    
    public static void release(StringBuilder sb) {
        sb.setLength(0); // Reset
        POOL.release(sb);
    }
    
    public static String buildString(String... parts) {
        StringBuilder sb = null;
        try {
            sb = acquire();
            for (String part : parts) {
                sb.append(part);
            }
            return sb.toString();
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            // Fallback to creating new StringBuilder
            StringBuilder fallback = new StringBuilder();
            for (String part : parts) {
                fallback.append(part);
            }
            return fallback.toString();
        } finally {
            if (sb != null) {
                release(sb);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

**Key Points to Discuss**:
- Thread safety using BlockingQueue
- Generic design for any object type
- Validation and cleanup mechanisms
- Resource management and shutdown

#### Q9: Design a cache with LRU eviction policy
**Companies**: Google, Meta, Amazon  
**Difficulty**: Hard  
**Category**: Data Structures + OOP

**Question**: Implement a thread-safe LRU (Least Recently Used) cache that supports generic key-value pairs with configurable maximum size.

**Solution**:
```java
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;

public class LRUCache<K, V> {
    private final int maxSize;
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<K, Node<K, V>> cache;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock;
    private Node<K, V> head;
    private Node<K, V> tail;
    
    private static class Node<K, V> {
        K key;
        V value;
        Node<K, V> prev;
        Node<K, V> next;
        long accessTime;
        
        Node(K key, V value) {
            this.key = key;
            this.value = value;
            this.accessTime = System.nanoTime();
        }
    }
    
    public LRUCache(int maxSize) {
        if (maxSize <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Max size must be positive");
        }
        
        this.maxSize = maxSize;
        this.cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
        
        // Initialize dummy head and tail nodes
        this.head = new Node<>(null, null);
        this.tail = new Node<>(null, null);
        head.next = tail;
        tail.prev = head;
    }
    
    public V get(K key) {
        if (key == null) return null;
        
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            Node<K, V> node = cache.get(key);
            if (node == null) {
                return null;
            }
            
            // Move to front (most recently used)
            moveToFront(node);
            node.accessTime = System.nanoTime();
            return node.value;
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    public void put(K key, V value) {
        if (key == null) return;
        
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            Node<K, V> existingNode = cache.get(key);
            
            if (existingNode != null) {
                // Update existing node
                existingNode.value = value;
                existingNode.accessTime = System.nanoTime();
                moveToFront(existingNode);
            } else {
                // Add new node
                Node<K, V> newNode = new Node<>(key, value);
                
                if (cache.size() >= maxSize) {
                    // Remove least recently used (tail)
                    removeLRU();
                }
                
                cache.put(key, newNode);
                addToFront(newNode);
            }
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    public V remove(K key) {
        if (key == null) return null;
        
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            Node<K, V> node = cache.remove(key);
            if (node != null) {
                removeFromList(node);
                return node.value;
            }
            return null;
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    private void moveToFront(Node<K, V> node) {
        removeFromList(node);
        addToFront(node);
    }
    
    private void addToFront(Node<K, V> node) {
        node.prev = head;
        node.next = head.next;
        head.next.prev = node;
        head.next = node;
    }
    
    private void removeFromList(Node<K, V> node) {
        node.prev.next = node.next;
        node.next.prev = node.prev;
    }
    
    private void removeLRU() {
        Node<K, V> lru = tail.prev;
        if (lru != head) {
            cache.remove(lru.key);
            removeFromList(lru);
        }
    }
    
    public int size() {
        return cache.size();
    }
    
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return cache.isEmpty();
    }
    
    public void clear() {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            cache.clear();
            head.next = tail;
            tail.prev = head;
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    // For debugging and monitoring
    public double getHitRate() {
        // Implementation would track hits/misses
        return 0.0; // Placeholder
    }
    
    public void printCacheState() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            System.out.println("Cache state (MRU to LRU):");
            Node<K, V> current = head.next;
            int position = 1;
            while (current != tail) {
                System.out.printf("%d. Key: %s, Value: %s%n", 
                    position++, current.key, current.value);
                current = current.next;
            }
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }
}

// Usage example
public class CacheExample {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        LRUCache<String, String> cache = new LRUCache<>(3);
        
        cache.put("1", "One");
        cache.put("2", "Two");
        cache.put("3", "Three");
        cache.printCacheState(); // 3, 2, 1
        
        cache.get("1"); // Access 1, moves to front
        cache.printCacheState(); // 1, 3, 2
        
        cache.put("4", "Four"); // Evicts 2 (LRU)
        cache.printCacheState(); // 4, 1, 3
    }
}
```

#### Q10: Implement a thread-safe counter with different increment strategies
**Companies**: Google, Microsoft, Meta  
**Difficulty**: Medium-Hard  
**Category**: Concurrency + Design Patterns

**Question**: Design a counter system that supports different increment strategies (by 1, by custom amount, exponential) and is thread-safe. Use the Strategy pattern.

**Solution**:
```java
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;

// Strategy interface
public interface IncrementStrategy {
    long increment(long currentValue, long parameter);
    String getStrategyName();
}

// Concrete strategies
public class LinearIncrementStrategy implements IncrementStrategy {
    @Override
    public long increment(long currentValue, long parameter) {
        return currentValue + parameter;
    }
    
    @Override
    public String getStrategyName() {
        return "Linear";
    }
}

public class ExponentialIncrementStrategy implements IncrementStrategy {
    @Override
    public long increment(long currentValue, long parameter) {
        if (currentValue == 0) return parameter;
        return currentValue * parameter;
    }
    
    @Override
    public String getStrategyName() {
        return "Exponential";
    }
}

public class FibonacciIncrementStrategy implements IncrementStrategy {
    private long previous = 0;
    private long current = 1;
    
    @Override
    public synchronized long increment(long currentValue, long parameter) {
        long next = previous + current;
        previous = current;
        current = next;
        return currentValue + next;
    }
    
    @Override
    public String getStrategyName() {
        return "Fibonacci";
    }
}

// Thread-safe counter with strategy pattern
public class StrategicCounter {
    private final AtomicLong value;
    private volatile IncrementStrategy strategy;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock strategyLock;
    private final AtomicLong operationCount;
    
    public StrategicCounter(IncrementStrategy initialStrategy) {
        this.value = new AtomicLong(0);
        this.strategy = initialStrategy;
        this.strategyLock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
        this.operationCount = new AtomicLong(0);
    }
    
    public long increment(long parameter) {
        strategyLock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            IncrementStrategy currentStrategy = this.strategy;
            long newValue = value.updateAndGet(current -> 
                currentStrategy.increment(current, parameter));
            operationCount.incrementAndGet();
            return newValue;
        } finally {
            strategyLock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    public long increment() {
        return increment(1);
    }
    
    public void setStrategy(IncrementStrategy newStrategy) {
        if (newStrategy == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Strategy cannot be null");
        }
        
        strategyLock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            this.strategy = newStrategy;
        } finally {
            strategyLock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    public IncrementStrategy getStrategy() {
        strategyLock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return strategy;
        } finally {
            strategyLock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    public long getValue() {
        return value.get();
    }
    
    public void reset() {
        value.set(0);
        operationCount.set(0);
    }
    
    public long getOperationCount() {
        return operationCount.get();
    }
    
    public CounterStats getStats() {
        strategyLock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return new CounterStats(
                value.get(),
                operationCount.get(),
                strategy.getStrategyName()
            );
        } finally {
            strategyLock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }
    
    // Immutable stats class
    public static class CounterStats {
        private final long currentValue;
        private final long totalOperations;
        private final String strategyName;
        
        public CounterStats(long currentValue, long totalOperations, String strategyName) {
            this.currentValue = currentValue;
            this.totalOperations = totalOperations;
            this.strategyName = strategyName;
        }
        
        public long getCurrentValue() { return currentValue; }
        public long getTotalOperations() { return totalOperations; }
        public String getStrategyName() { return strategyName; }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.format("CounterStats{value=%d, operations=%d, strategy='%s'}", 
                currentValue, totalOperations, strategyName);
        }
    }
}

// Usage and testing
public class StrategicCounterDemo {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
        StrategicCounter counter = new StrategicCounter(new LinearIncrementStrategy());
        
        // Test with multiple threads
        int numThreads = 4;
        int operationsPerThread = 1000;
        Thread[] threads = new Thread[numThreads];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < numThreads; i++) {
            final int threadId = i;
            threads[i] = new Thread(() -> {
                for (int j = 0; j < operationsPerThread; j++) {
                    counter.increment(threadId + 1);
                    
                    // Change strategy occasionally
                    if (j % 100 == 0) {
                        switch (j / 100 % 3) {
                            case 0:
                                counter.setStrategy(new LinearIncrementStrategy());
                                break;
                            case 1:
                                counter.setStrategy(new ExponentialIncrementStrategy());
                                break;
                            case 2:
                                counter.setStrategy(new FibonacciIncrementStrategy());
                                break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        
        // Start all threads
        for (Thread thread : threads) {
            thread.start();
        }
        
        // Wait for completion
        for (Thread thread : threads) {
            thread.join();
        }
        
        System.out.println("Final stats: " + counter.getStats());
    }
}
```
