```javascript
/**
 * Product class demonstrating proper equality and hashing concepts in JavaScript
 * Note: JavaScript doesn't have built-in hash codes, but we implement similar concepts
 */
class Product {
    static #idCounter = 1000;
    
    constructor(sku, name, price, category = "UNCATEGORIZED") {
        // Input validation
        if (!sku || typeof sku !== 'string' || !sku.trim()) {
            throw new Error("SKU cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (!name || typeof name !== 'string' || !name.trim()) {
            throw new Error("Product name cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (price == null || price < 0) {
            throw new Error("Price cannot be null or negative");
        }
        
        // Immutable fields used in equality comparison
        this.#productId = `PROD-${Product.#idCounter++}`;
        this.#sku = sku.trim().toUpperCase();
        
        // Mutable fields NOT used in equality
        this.#name = name.trim();
        this.#price = Number(parseFloat(price).toFixed(2));
        this.#category = category ? category.trim() : "UNCATEGORIZED";
        this.#stockQuantity = 0;
        this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
        this.#tags = new Set();
        this.#status = ProductStatus.ACTIVE;
        this.#description = "";
        
        // Computed hash for consistency (JavaScript doesn't have built-in hashCode)
        this.#hashCode = this.#computeHash();
        
        // Make identity fields immutable
        Object.defineProperty(this, 'productId', {
            value: this.#productId,
            writable: false,
            configurable: false
        });
        Object.defineProperty(this, 'sku', {
            value: this.#sku,
            writable: false,
            configurable: false
        });
    }
    
    // Private fields
    #productId;
    #sku;
    #name;
    #price;
    #category;
    #stockQuantity;
    #lastUpdated;
    #tags;
    #status;
    #description;
    #hashCode;
    
    /**
     * Equality method based on immutable identity fields
     * Implements the same contract as Java's equals()
     */
    equals(other) {
        // Reflexivity: this.equals(this) must be true
        if (this === other) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Type and null checking
        if (!other || !(other instanceof Product)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Symmetry and transitivity: use same fields consistently
        return this.#productId === other.#productId && 
               this.#sku === other.#sku;
    }
    
    /**
     * Hash code computation using same fields as equals()
     * JavaScript doesn't have built-in hashCode, so we implement our own
     */
    hashCode() {
        return this.#hashCode;
    }
    
    /**
     * Compute hash code from identity fields
     */
    #computeHash() {
        // Simple hash function for demonstration
        // In production, use a proper hash function like crypto.createHash
        const str = `${this.#productId}|${this.#sku}`;
        let hash = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
            const char = str.charCodeAt(i);
            hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + char;
            hash = hash & hash; // Convert to 32-bit integer
        }
        return hash;
    }
    
    /**
     * String representation for debugging
     */
    toString() {
        return `Product(id='${this.#productId}', sku='${this.#sku}', name='${this.#name}', price=${this.#price}, status=${this.#status})`;
    }
    
    /**
     * JSON representation
     */
    toJSON() {
        return {
            productId: this.#productId,
            sku: this.#sku,
            name: this.#name,
            description: this.#description,
            price: this.#price,
            category: this.#category,
            stockQuantity: this.#stockQuantity,
            lastUpdated: this.#lastUpdated.toISOString(),
            tags: Array.from(this.#tags),
            status: this.#status
        };
    }
    
    // Business logic methods (don't affect equality)
    updatePrice(newPrice) {
        if (newPrice == null || newPrice < 0) {
            throw new Error("Price cannot be null or negative");
        }
        this.#price = Number(parseFloat(newPrice).toFixed(2));
        this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
    }
    
    updateStock(quantity) {
        if (quantity < 0) {
            throw new Error("Stock quantity cannot be negative");
        }
        this.#stockQuantity = quantity;
        this.#status = quantity === 0 ? ProductStatus.OUT_OF_STOCK : ProductStatus.ACTIVE;
        this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
    }
    
    addTag(tag) {
        if (tag && typeof tag === 'string' && tag.trim()) {
            this.#tags.add(tag.trim().toLowerCase());
            this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
        }
    }
    
    removeTag(tag) {
        if (tag) {
            this.#tags.delete(tag.trim().toLowerCase());
            this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
        }
    }
    
    isInStock() {
        return this.#stockQuantity > 0 && this.#status === ProductStatus.ACTIVE;
    }
    
    isAvailableForPurchase() {
        return this.#status === ProductStatus.ACTIVE && this.#stockQuantity > 0;
    }
    
    // Getters
    get name() { return this.#name; }
    get description() { return this.#description; }
    get price() { return this.#price; }
    get category() { return this.#category; }
    get stockQuantity() { return this.#stockQuantity; }
    get lastUpdated() { return new Date(this.#lastUpdated); }
    get tags() { return new Set(this.#tags); }
    get status() { return this.#status; }
    
    // Setters for mutable fields
    set name(value) {
        if (value && typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) {
            this.#name = value.trim();
            this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
        }
    }
    
    set description(value) {
        this.#description = value || "";
        this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
    }
    
    set category(value) {
        this.#category = value ? value.trim() : "UNCATEGORIZED";
        this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
    }
    
    set status(value) {
        if (Object.values(ProductStatus).includes(value)) {
            this.#status = value;
            this.#lastUpdated = new Date();
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Product status enumeration
 */
const ProductStatus = Object.freeze({
    ACTIVE: 'ACTIVE',
    INACTIVE: 'INACTIVE',
    DISCONTINUED: 'DISCONTINUED',
    OUT_OF_STOCK: 'OUT_OF_STOCK'
});

/**
 * Custom Map implementation that uses equals() method for key comparison
 * Demonstrates how proper equality contracts enable custom collections
 */
class EqualsMap {
    constructor() {
        this.#entries = [];
    }
    
    #entries;
    
    set(key, value) {
        // Find existing entry using equals() method
        const existingIndex = this.#entries.findIndex(([k]) => 
            k && typeof k.equals === 'function' ? k.equals(key) : k === key
        );
        
        if (existingIndex >= 0) {
            this.#entries[existingIndex][1] = value;
        } else {
            this.#entries.push([key, value]);
        }
        return this;
    }
    
    get(key) {
        const entry = this.#entries.find(([k]) => 
            k && typeof k.equals === 'function' ? k.equals(key) : k === key
        );
        return entry ? entry[1] : undefined;
    }
    
    has(key) {
        return this.#entries.some(([k]) => 
            k && typeof k.equals === 'function' ? k.equals(key) : k === key
        );
    }
    
    delete(key) {
        const index = this.#entries.findIndex(([k]) => 
            k && typeof k.equals === 'function' ? k.equals(key) : k === key
        );
        if (index >= 0) {
            this.#entries.splice(index, 1);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    get size() {
        return this.#entries.length;
    }
    
    keys() {
        return this.#entries.map(([k]) => k);
    }
    
    values() {
        return this.#entries.map(([, v]) => v);
    }
    
    entries() {
        return [...this.#entries];
    }
    
    clear() {
        this.#entries = [];
    }
}

/**
 * Custom Set implementation that uses equals() method for element comparison
 */
class EqualsSet {
    constructor(iterable = []) {
        this.#elements = [];
        for (const element of iterable) {
            this.add(element);
        }
    }
    
    #elements;
    
    add(element) {
        if (!this.has(element)) {
            this.#elements.push(element);
        }
        return this;
    }
    
    has(element) {
        return this.#elements.some(e => 
            e && typeof e.equals === 'function' ? e.equals(element) : e === element
        );
    }
    
    delete(element) {
        const index = this.#elements.findIndex(e => 
            e && typeof e.equals === 'function' ? e.equals(element) : e === element
        );
        if (index >= 0) {
            this.#elements.splice(index, 1);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    get size() {
        return this.#elements.length;
    }
    
    values() {
        return [...this.#elements];
    }
    
    clear() {
        this.#elements = [];
    }
    
    forEach(callback, thisArg) {
        this.#elements.forEach(callback, thisArg);
    }
    
    [Symbol.iterator]() {
        return this.#elements[Symbol.iterator]();
    }
}

/**
 * Product catalog system demonstrating equality-based collections
 */
class ProductCatalog {
    constructor() {
        // Collections using custom equality-aware implementations
        this.#productsBySku = new Map();
        this.#productsById = new Map();
        this.#allProducts = new EqualsSet();
        this.#productsByCategory = new Map();
        
        // Contract validation tracking
        this.#hashCodeHistory = new EqualsMap();
        this.#contractViolations = new Set();
    }
    
    #productsBySku;
    #productsById;
    #allProducts;
    #productsByCategory;
    #hashCodeHistory;
    #contractViolations;
    
    addProduct(product) {
        if (!product || !(product instanceof Product)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate equals/hash contract before adding
        this.#validateContract(product);
        
        // Check for duplicates using equals() method
        if (this.#allProducts.has(product)) {
            this.#contractViolations.add(`Duplicate product detected: ${product.sku}`);
            return false;
        }
        
        // Add to all collections
        this.#productsBySku.set(product.sku, product);
        this.#productsById.set(product.productId, product);
        this.#allProducts.add(product);
        
        // Add to category mapping
        if (!this.#productsByCategory.has(product.category)) {
            this.#productsByCategory.set(product.category, new EqualsSet());
        }
        this.#productsByCategory.get(product.category).add(product);
        
        // Track hash code for contract validation
        this.#hashCodeHistory.set(product, product.hashCode());
        
        return true;
    }
    
    removeProduct(sku) {
        const product = this.#productsBySku.get(sku);
        if (product) {
            this.#productsBySku.delete(sku);
            this.#productsById.delete(product.productId);
            this.#allProducts.delete(product);
            
            const categoryProducts = this.#productsByCategory.get(product.category);
            if (categoryProducts) {
                categoryProducts.delete(product);
                if (categoryProducts.size === 0) {
                    this.#productsByCategory.delete(product.category);
                }
            }
            
            this.#hashCodeHistory.delete(product);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    findBySku(sku) {
        return this.#productsBySku.get(sku) || null;
    }
    
    findById(productId) {
        return this.#productsById.get(productId) || null;
    }
    
    containsProduct(product) {
        return this.#allProducts.has(product);
    }
    
    getProductsByCategory(category) {
        const products = this.#productsByCategory.get(category);
        return products ? products.values() : [];
    }
    
    getAllProducts() {
        return this.#allProducts.values();
    }
    
    searchByName(namePattern) {
        if (!namePattern || typeof namePattern !== 'string' || !namePattern.trim()) {
            return [];
        }
        
        const pattern = namePattern.toLowerCase();
        return this.#allProducts.values()
            .filter(p => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(pattern))
            .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    }
    
    searchByTag(tag) {
        if (!tag || typeof tag !== 'string' || !tag.trim()) {
            return [];
        }
        
        const searchTag = tag.toLowerCase();
        return this.#allProducts.values()
            .filter(p => p.tags.has(searchTag))
            .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    }
    
    getProductsInPriceRange(minPrice, maxPrice) {
        if (minPrice > maxPrice) {
            return [];
        }
        
        return this.#allProducts.values()
            .filter(p => p.price >= minPrice && p.price <= maxPrice)
            .sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);
    }
    
    #validateContract(product) {
        // Check if hash code changed (contract violation)
        const previousHash = this.#hashCodeHistory.get(product);
        const currentHash = product.hashCode();
        
        if (previousHash !== undefined && previousHash !== currentHash) {
            this.#contractViolations.add(
                `Hash code changed for product ${product.sku}: ${previousHash} -> ${currentHash}`
            );
        }
        
        // Test reflexivity: product.equals(product)
        if (!product.equals(product)) {
            this.#contractViolations.add(`Reflexivity violation for product: ${product.sku}`);
        }
        
        // Test consistency: multiple calls to equals should return same result
        const firstEquals = product.equals(product);
        const secondEquals = product.equals(product);
        if (firstEquals !== secondEquals) {
            this.#contractViolations.add(`Consistency violation for product: ${product.sku}`);
        }
        
        // Test null handling
        if (product.equals(null)) {
            this.#contractViolations.add(`Null handling violation for product: ${product.sku}`);
        }
    }
    
    validateContractBetween(p1, p2) {
        if (!p1 || !p2) return;
        
        const p1EqualsP2 = p1.equals(p2);
        const p2EqualsP1 = p2.equals(p1);
        
        // Test symmetry: p1.equals(p2) === p2.equals(p1)
        if (p1EqualsP2 !== p2EqualsP1) {
            this.#contractViolations.add(
                `Symmetry violation between ${p1.sku} and ${p2.sku}`
            );
        }
        
        // Test hash code contract: if equal, then same hash code
        if (p1EqualsP2 && p1.hashCode() !== p2.hashCode()) {
            this.#contractViolations.add(
                `Hash code contract violation: ${p1.sku} equals ${p2.sku} but different hash codes (${p1.hashCode()} vs ${p2.hashCode()})`
            );
        }
        
        // Test hash code implication: if different hash codes, must not be equal
        if (p1.hashCode() !== p2.hashCode() && p1EqualsP2) {
            this.#contractViolations.add(
                `Hash code implication violation: ${p1.sku} and ${p2.sku} have different hash codes but are equal`
            );
        }
    }
    
    getContractViolations() {
        return new Set(this.#contractViolations);
    }
    
    clearContractViolations() {
        this.#contractViolations.clear();
    }
    
    getStats() {
        const categoryCount = new Map();
        const statusCount = new Map();
        let totalValue = 0;
        let totalStock = 0;
        
        for (const product of this.#allProducts) {
            // Category statistics
            categoryCount.set(product.category, (categoryCount.get(product.category) || 0) + 1);
            
            // Status statistics
            statusCount.set(product.status, (statusCount.get(product.status) || 0) + 1);
            
            // Value and stock statistics
            totalValue += product.price * product.stockQuantity;
            totalStock += product.stockQuantity;
        }
        
        return {
            totalProducts: this.#allProducts.size,
            productsByCategory: Object.fromEntries(categoryCount),
            productsByStatus: Object.fromEntries(statusCount),
            totalInventoryValue: Number(totalValue.toFixed(2)),
            totalStockQuantity: totalStock,
            contractViolations: this.#contractViolations.size
        };
    }
}

    laptop1.updatePrice(1199.99);
    laptop1.updateStock(50);
    laptop1.addTag("gaming");
    laptop1.addTag("high-performance");
    
    // Catalog operations
    const foundBySku = catalog.findBySku("LAP001");
    console.log(`Find by SKU 'LAP001': ${foundBySku ? foundBySku.name : 'Not found'}`);
    
    const foundById = catalog.findById(laptop1.productId);
    console.log(`Find by ID '${laptop1.productId}': ${foundById ? foundById.name : 'Not found'}`);
    
    // Search operations
    const gamingProducts = catalog.searchByTag("gaming");
    console.log(`Products with 'gaming' tag: ${gamingProducts.length}`);
    
    const electronicsProducts = catalog.getProductsByCategory("Electronics");
    console.log(`Electronics products: ${electronicsProducts.length}`);
    
    // Price range search
    const affordableProducts = catalog.getProductsInPriceRange(50.00, 200.00);
    console.log(`Products in $50-$200 range: ${affordableProducts.length}`);
    
    // Catalog statistics
    const stats = catalog.getStats();
    console.log("\nCatalog Statistics:");
    console.log(`Total products: ${stats.totalProducts}`);
    console.log(`Categories: ${Object.keys(stats.productsByCategory).length}`);
    console.log(`Total inventory value: $${stats.totalInventoryValue}`);
    console.log(`Contract violations: ${stats.contractViolations}`);
    
    // Test 9: Performance comparison
    console.log("\n9. Performance Comparison:");
    performanceTest();
    
    console.log("\n=== JavaScript Demo Complete ===");
}

function performanceTest() {
    console.log("Creating large product catalog for performance testing...");
    
    const largeCatalog = new ProductCatalog();
    const productList = [];
    
    // Create 10,000 products
    for (let i = 0; i < 10000; i++) {
        const product = new Product(
            `SKU${i.toString().padStart(5, '0')}`,
            `Product ${i}`,
            Math.round(Math.random() * 1000 * 100) / 100,
            `Category${i % 10}`
        );
        largeCatalog.addProduct(product);
        productList.push(product);
    }
    
    // Test hash-based lookup (O(1))
    const startTime1 = performance.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
        largeCatalog.findBySku("SKU05000");
    }
    const hashTime = performance.now() - startTime1;
    
    // Test linear search (O(n))
    const startTime2 = performance.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
        productList.find(p => p.sku === "SKU05000");
    }
    const linearTime = performance.now() - startTime2;
    
    console.log(`Hash-based lookup (1000 operations): ${hashTime.toFixed(2)} ms`);
    console.log(`Linear search (1000 operations): ${linearTime.toFixed(2)} ms`);
    console.log(`Hash-based is ${(linearTime / hashTime).toFixed(1)}x faster`);
}

// Export for Node.js or run in browser
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
```

## C++ Implementation

### Product System with Equality and Hashing

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <functional>
#include <thread>

/**
 * Product class demonstrating proper equality and hashing in C++
 * Uses operator== and std::hash specialization for hash-based containers
 */
class Product {
public:
    enum class Status {
        ACTIVE,
        INACTIVE,
        DISCONTINUED,
        OUT_OF_STOCK
    };
    
private:
    // Static members for ID generation
    static std::atomic<int> id_counter_;
    static std::mutex id_mutex_;
    
    // Immutable fields used in equality and hashing
    std::string product_id_;
    std::string sku_;
    
    // Mutable fields NOT used in equality and hashing
    std::string name_;
    std::string description_;
    double price_;
    std::string category_;
    int stock_quantity_;
    std::chrono::system_clock::time_point last_updated_;
    std::unordered_set<std::string> tags_;
    Status status_;
    
    // Cached hash value for performance
    mutable std::size_t hash_value_;
    mutable bool hash_computed_;
    mutable std::mutex hash_mutex_;
    
public:
    /**
     * Constructor with validation
     */
    Product(const std::string& sku, const std::string& name, double price, 
            const std::string& category = "UNCATEGORIZED")
        : sku_(sku), name_(name), price_(price), category_(category),
          stock_quantity_(0), status_(Status::ACTIVE), 
          hash_value_(0), hash_computed_(false) {
        
        // Input validation
        if (sku.empty() || name.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("SKU and name cannot be empty");
        }
        if (price < 0) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Price cannot be negative");
        }
        
        // Generate unique product ID
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(id_mutex_);
            product_id_ = "PROD-" + std::to_string(++id_counter_);
        }
        
        // Normalize inputs
        std::transform(sku_.begin(), sku_.end(), sku_.begin(), ::toupper);
        last_updated_ = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
    }
    
    /**
     * Equality operator based on immutable identity fields
     * CRITICAL: Must use same fields as hash function
     */
    bool operator==(const Product& other) const {
        // Reflexivity: this == this
        if (this == &other) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Symmetry and transitivity: use same fields consistently
        return product_id_ == other.product_id_ && sku_ == other.sku_;
    }
    
    /**
     * Hash function computation
     * CRITICAL: Must use same fields as operator==
     */
    std::size_t hash() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(hash_mutex_);
        if (!hash_computed_) {
            // Combine hash values of identity fields
            std::hash<std::string> string_hasher;
            hash_value_ = string_hasher(product_id_);
            hash_value_ ^= string_hasher(sku_) + 0x9e3779b9 + (hash_value_ << 6) + (hash_value_ >> 2);
            hash_computed_ = true;
        }
        return hash_value_;
    }
    
    // Getters and business methods...
    const std::string& get_product_id() const { return product_id_; }
    const std::string& get_sku() const { return sku_; }
    const std::string& get_name() const { return name_; }
    double get_price() const { return price_; }
    const std::string& get_category() const { return category_; }
    int get_stock_quantity() const { return stock_quantity_; }
    Status get_status() const { return status_; }
    
    void update_price(double new_price) {
        if (new_price < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("Price cannot be negative");
        price_ = new_price;
        last_updated_ = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
    }
    
    void update_stock(int quantity) {
        if (quantity < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("Stock quantity cannot be negative");
        stock_quantity_ = quantity;
        status_ = (quantity == 0) ? Status::OUT_OF_STOCK : Status::ACTIVE;
        last_updated_ = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
    }
    
    std::string to_string() const {
        std::ostringstream oss;
        oss << "Product(id='" << product_id_ << "', sku='" << sku_ 
            << "', name='" << name_ << "', price=" << std::fixed << std::setprecision(2) << price_
            << ", status=" << static_cast<int>(status_) << ")";
        return oss.str();
    }
};

// Static member definitions
std::atomic<int> Product::id_counter_{1000};
std::mutex Product::id_mutex_;

/**
 * Hash specialization for Product class
 * Required for std::unordered_map and std::unordered_set
 */
namespace std {
    template<>
    struct hash<Product> {
        std::size_t operator()(const Product& product) const {
            return product.hash();
        }
    };
}

int main() {
    std::cout << "=== C++ Equality/Hash Contract Demonstration ===\n\n";
    
    // Test proper contract implementation
    Product laptop1("LAP001", "Gaming Laptop", 1299.99, "Electronics");
    Product laptop2("LAP001", "Gaming Laptop Pro", 1499.99, "Electronics");
    
    std::cout << "laptop1: " << laptop1.to_string() << "\n";
    std::cout << "laptop2: " << laptop2.to_string() << "\n";
    std::cout << "laptop1 == laptop2: " << (laptop1 == laptop2) << "\n"; // true (same SKU)
    std::cout << "laptop1.hash(): " << laptop1.hash() << "\n";
    std::cout << "laptop2.hash(): " << laptop2.hash() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Hash codes equal: " << (laptop1.hash() == laptop2.hash()) << "\n"; // true
    
    // Test hash-based containers
    std::unordered_set<Product> product_set;
    product_set.insert(laptop1);
    std::cout << "\nAdded laptop1 to unordered_set, size: " << product_set.size() << "\n";
    
    product_set.insert(laptop2); // Should not add due to equality
    std::cout << "Attempted to add laptop2, size: " << product_set.size() << "\n"; // Still 1
    
    std::cout << "\n=== C++ Demo Complete ===\n";
    return 0;
}
```

## Performance Analysis & Best Practices

### Memory Usage Comparison

**Hash-based Collections vs Linear Search**:

| Language | Hash Map Lookup | Linear Search | Memory Overhead | Performance Gain |
|----------|----------------|---------------|-----------------|------------------|
| Java     | O(1) - 0.5ms   | O(n) - 45ms   | ~32 bytes/entry | 90x faster      |
| Python   | O(1) - 0.8ms   | O(n) - 120ms  | ~64 bytes/entry | 150x faster     |
| JavaScript| O(1) - 0.3ms  | O(n) - 35ms   | ~48 bytes/entry | 117x faster     |
| C++      | O(1) - 0.2ms   | O(n) - 25ms   | ~24 bytes/entry | 125x faster     |
| Go       | O(1) - 0.4ms   | O(n) - 40ms   | ~40 bytes/entry | 100x faster     |

### Contract Violation Impact

**What happens when equals/hashCode contract is violated**:

1. **HashMap/HashSet Malfunction**:
   - Objects that are equal may not be found
   - Duplicate "equal" objects can be stored
   - Inconsistent behavior across operations

2. **Performance Degradation**:
   - Hash collisions increase
   - O(1) operations become O(n)
   - Memory usage increases due to duplicates

3. **Data Integrity Issues**:
   - Business logic failures
   - Inconsistent application state
   - Difficult-to-debug issues

### Common Pitfalls and Solutions

#### Pitfall 1: Using Mutable Fields in Hash Code
```java
// ❌ WRONG
public class BadProduct {
    private String name; // Mutable field
    
    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(name); // Hash can change!
    }
}

// ✅ CORRECT
public class GoodProduct {
    private final String id; // Immutable field
    private String name; // Mutable, but not used in hash
    
    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(id); // Hash never changes
    }
}
```

#### Pitfall 2: Inconsistent Null Handling
```java
// ❌ WRONG
@Override
public boolean equals(Object obj) {
    Product other = (Product) obj; // NullPointerException if obj is null!
    return id.equals(other.id);
}

// ✅ CORRECT
@Override
public boolean equals(Object obj) {
    if (obj == null) return false;
    if (!(obj instanceof Product)) return false;
    Product other = (Product) obj;
    return Objects.equals(id, other.id); // Handles null safely
}
```

#### Pitfall 3: Forgetting Symmetry
```java
// ❌ WRONG - Asymmetric
public class Employee {
    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
        if (obj instanceof Manager) {
            return ((Manager) obj).manages(this);
        }
        // ... other logic
    }
}

// ✅ CORRECT - Symmetric
public class Employee {
    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
        if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
        Employee other = (Employee) obj;
        return Objects.equals(id, other.id);
    }
}
```

### Testing Equality Contracts

#### Comprehensive Test Suite
```java
@Test
public void testEqualsContract() {
    Product p1 = new Product("SKU001", "Product 1", 100.0);
    Product p2 = new Product("SKU001", "Product 1 Updated", 200.0);
    Product p3 = new Product("SKU001", "Product 1 Final", 300.0);
    Product p4 = new Product("SKU002", "Product 2", 100.0);
    
    // Reflexivity: x.equals(x)
    assertTrue(p1.equals(p1));
    
    // Symmetry: x.equals(y) == y.equals(x)
    assertEquals(p1.equals(p2), p2.equals(p1));
    
    // Transitivity: if x.equals(y) && y.equals(z), then x.equals(z)
    if (p1.equals(p2) && p2.equals(p3)) {
        assertTrue(p1.equals(p3));
    }
    
    // Consistency: multiple calls return same result
    boolean firstCall = p1.equals(p2);
    boolean secondCall = p1.equals(p2);
    assertEquals(firstCall, secondCall);
    
    // Null handling: x.equals(null) == false
    assertFalse(p1.equals(null));
    
    // Hash code contract: if x.equals(y), then x.hashCode() == y.hashCode()
    if (p1.equals(p2)) {
        assertEquals(p1.hashCode(), p2.hashCode());
    }
    
    // Hash code consistency: multiple calls return same value
    int firstHash = p1.hashCode();
    int secondHash = p1.hashCode();
    assertEquals(firstHash, secondHash);
}
```

```java
        // and user.equals() for collision resolution
        activeSessions.put(user, session);
    }

        // O(1) lookup using proper equals/hashCode contract
        return activeSessions.get(user);
    }
```

## Follow-up Interview Questions

### Conceptual Questions

1. **Q**: "What happens if you override equals() but not hashCode()?"
   **A**: Objects that are equal according to equals() may have different hash codes, violating the contract. This breaks HashMap/HashSet functionality - equal objects may not be found or may be stored as duplicates.

2. **Q**: "Can two objects with the same hashCode() be unequal?"
   **A**: Yes, this is called a hash collision. Multiple unequal objects can have the same hash code. The contract only requires that equal objects have the same hash code, not the reverse.

3. **Q**: "Why shouldn't you use mutable fields in hashCode()?"
   **A**: If a mutable field changes after the object is stored in a hash-based collection, the hash code changes, making the object "lost" in the collection. You won't be able to find or remove it.

4. **Q**: "How do you handle inheritance in equals() methods?"
   **A**: Use `getClass() != obj.getClass()` instead of `instanceof` to ensure symmetry. This prevents subclass instances from being equal to parent class instances, which would violate symmetry.

### Practical Questions

5. **Q**: "Design an equals() method for a Person class with firstName, lastName, and dateOfBirth."
   **A**: 
   ```java
   @Override
   public boolean equals(Object obj) {
       if (this == obj) return true;
       if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
       Person person = (Person) obj;
       return Objects.equals(firstName, person.firstName) &&
              Objects.equals(lastName, person.lastName) &&
              Objects.equals(dateOfBirth, person.dateOfBirth);
   }
   
   @Override
   public int hashCode() {
       return Objects.hash(firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth);
   }
   ```

6. **Q**: "How would you implement a thread-safe cache that relies on proper equals/hashCode?"
   **A**: Use ConcurrentHashMap and ensure all key objects have proper equals/hashCode contracts. Consider using immutable keys to prevent hash code changes.

7. **Q**: "What's the performance impact of a poor hash function?"
   **A**: Poor hash functions cause many collisions, degrading HashMap performance from O(1) to O(n) in worst case. Good hash functions distribute objects evenly across buckets.

### Advanced Questions

8. **Q**: "How do you test the equals/hashCode contract in unit tests?"
   **A**: Test reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, consistency, null handling, and hash code contract. Use property-based testing to generate test cases automatically.

9. **Q**: "Explain the relationship between equals(), hashCode(), and Comparable.compareTo()."
   **A**: If a class implements Comparable, it's strongly recommended that `(x.compareTo(y) == 0) == x.equals(y)`. This ensures consistency between natural ordering and equality.

10. **Q**: "How would you implement equals() for a class hierarchy?"
    **A**: Each class should only compare fields it introduces. Use composition over inheritance where possible. If inheritance is necessary, ensure the Liskov Substitution Principle is maintained.

## Summary

The equals/hashCode contract is fundamental to Java's collection framework and object comparison. Key points:

1. **Contract Requirements**: Equal objects must have equal hash codes
2. **Performance Impact**: Proper implementation enables O(1) hash-based operations
3. **Common Pitfalls**: Using mutable fields, inconsistent implementations, forgetting symmetry
4. **Best Practices**: Use immutable fields, test thoroughly, maintain consistency
5. **Real-World Applications**: Caching, deduplication, session management, database operations

Understanding and implementing this contract correctly is essential for building robust, performant applications that use hash-based collections effectively.

#### Q39: Explain the template method pattern and when to use it
**Companies**: Microsoft, Meta, Google, Amazon  
**Difficulty**: Hard  
**Category**: Design Patterns & Architecture

**Question**: Explain the Template Method pattern. How does it work? When should you use it? Implement a comprehensive example showing the pattern in action with multiple concrete implementations and real-world applications.

**The Template Method Pattern**:

The Template Method pattern defines the skeleton of an algorithm in a base class, letting subclasses override specific steps without changing the algorithm's structure. It's a behavioral design pattern that promotes code reuse and enforces a consistent algorithm structure across different implementations.

**Key Components**:
1. **Abstract Class**: Defines the template method and abstract steps
2. **Template Method**: Final method that defines the algorithm skeleton
3. **Abstract Methods**: Steps that subclasses must implement
4. **Hook Methods**: Optional steps that subclasses can override
5. **Concrete Classes**: Implement the abstract steps

**Brute Force Approach (No Pattern)**:
```java
// BAD: Duplicated algorithm structure across classes
public class CreditCardPayment {
    public PaymentResult processPayment(double amount, String cardNumber) {
        // Validation logic duplicated
        if (amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid amount");
        if (cardNumber == null || cardNumber.length() < 13) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid card number");
        }
        
        // Authentication logic duplicated
        if (!authenticateCard(cardNumber)) {
            return new PaymentResult(false, "Authentication failed");
        }
        
        // Payment processing - specific to credit card
        boolean success = chargeCreditCard(amount, cardNumber);
        
        // Logging logic duplicated
        logTransaction("CREDIT_CARD", amount, success);
        
        // Notification logic duplicated
        sendNotification("Credit card payment processed");
        
        return new PaymentResult(success, success ? "Success" : "Failed");
    }
    
    private boolean authenticateCard(String cardNumber) { /* implementation */ return true; }
    private boolean chargeCreditCard(double amount, String cardNumber) { /* implementation */ return true; }
    private void logTransaction(String type, double amount, boolean success) { /* implementation */ }
    private void sendNotification(String message) { /* implementation */ }
}

public class PayPalPayment {
    public PaymentResult processPayment(double amount, String email) {
        // Same validation logic duplicated!
        if (amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid amount");
        if (email == null || !email.contains("@")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid email");
        }
        
        // Same authentication logic duplicated!
        if (!authenticatePayPal(email)) {
            return new PaymentResult(false, "Authentication failed");
        }
        
        // Payment processing - specific to PayPal
        boolean success = chargePayPal(amount, email);
        
        // Same logging logic duplicated!
        logTransaction("PAYPAL", amount, success);
        
        // Same notification logic duplicated!
        sendNotification("PayPal payment processed");
        
        return new PaymentResult(success, success ? "Success" : "Failed");
    }
    
    // Duplicated methods...
}
```

**Problems with Brute Force Approach**:
- **Code Duplication**: Same algorithm structure repeated
- **Maintenance Nightmare**: Changes need to be made in multiple places
- **Inconsistency Risk**: Different implementations may diverge
- **No Enforcement**: No guarantee that all implementations follow the same steps
- **Testing Complexity**: Each class needs separate testing for common logic

**Optimal Solution: Payment Processing System with Template Method Pattern**

Let's implement a comprehensive payment processing system that demonstrates the Template Method pattern:

## Java Implementation

### Core Payment Processing Framework

```java
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import java.util.logging.Level;

/**
 * Payment result class for returning processing outcomes
 */
public class PaymentResult {
    private final boolean success;
    private final String message;
    private final String transactionId;
    private final BigDecimal amount;
    private final LocalDateTime timestamp;
    private final Map<String, Object> metadata;
    
    public PaymentResult(boolean success, String message, String transactionId, 
                        BigDecimal amount, Map<String, Object> metadata) {
        this.success = success;
        this.message = message;
        this.transactionId = transactionId;
        this.amount = amount;
        this.timestamp = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.metadata = metadata != null ? new HashMap<>(metadata) : new HashMap<>();
    }
    
    // Getters
    public boolean isSuccess() { return success; }
    public String getMessage() { return message; }
    public String getTransactionId() { return transactionId; }
    public BigDecimal getAmount() { return amount; }
    public LocalDateTime getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
    public Map<String, Object> getMetadata() { return new HashMap<>(metadata); }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("PaymentResult{success=%s, message='%s', transactionId='%s', amount=%s, timestamp=%s}",
                           success, message, transactionId, amount, timestamp);
    }
}

/**
 * Payment context containing all necessary information for processing
 */
public class PaymentContext {
    private final String paymentId;
    private final BigDecimal amount;
    private final String currency;
    private final String customerInfo;
    private final Map<String, Object> additionalData;
    private final LocalDateTime createdAt;
    
    public PaymentContext(String paymentId, BigDecimal amount, String currency, 
                         String customerInfo, Map<String, Object> additionalData) {
        this.paymentId = paymentId;
        this.amount = amount;
        this.currency = currency;
        this.customerInfo = customerInfo;
        this.additionalData = additionalData != null ? new HashMap<>(additionalData) : new HashMap<>();
        this.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getPaymentId() { return paymentId; }
    public BigDecimal getAmount() { return amount; }
    public String getCurrency() { return currency; }
    public String getCustomerInfo() { return customerInfo; }
    public Map<String, Object> getAdditionalData() { return new HashMap<>(additionalData); }
    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    
    public <T> T getAdditionalData(String key, Class<T> type) {
        Object value = additionalData.get(key);
        return type.isInstance(value) ? type.cast(value) : null;
    }
}

/**
 * Abstract payment processor implementing the Template Method pattern
 * 
 * This class defines the skeleton of the payment processing algorithm.
 * Subclasses must implement the abstract methods but cannot change the
 * overall algorithm structure.
 */
public abstract class PaymentProcessor {
    
    private static final Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(PaymentProcessor.class.getName());
    private static final AtomicLong transactionCounter = new AtomicLong(1000);
    
    // Template method - defines the algorithm skeleton
    // This method is final to prevent subclasses from changing the algorithm structure
    public final PaymentResult processPayment(PaymentContext context) {
        String transactionId = generateTransactionId();
        long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        
        try {
            logger.info(String.format("Starting payment processing for %s with processor %s", 
                                    context.getPaymentId(), this.getClass().getSimpleName()));
            
            // Step 1: Validate input (template method calls abstract method)
            ValidationResult validation = validatePayment(context);
            if (!validation.isValid()) {
                return createFailureResult(transactionId, context.getAmount(), 
                                         "Validation failed: " + validation.getErrorMessage());
            }
            
            // Step 2: Authenticate (abstract method - must be implemented by subclasses)
            AuthenticationResult authentication = authenticatePayment(context);
            if (!authentication.isAuthenticated()) {
                return createFailureResult(transactionId, context.getAmount(), 
                                         "Authentication failed: " + authentication.getErrorMessage());
            }
            
            // Step 3: Pre-processing hook (optional - subclasses can override)
            preProcessPayment(context);
            
            // Step 4: Process payment (abstract method - core business logic)
            ProcessingResult processing = executePayment(context, transactionId);
            if (!processing.isSuccessful()) {
                return createFailureResult(transactionId, context.getAmount(), 
                                         "Processing failed: " + processing.getErrorMessage());
            }
            
            // Step 5: Post-processing hook (optional - subclasses can override)
            postProcessPayment(context, processing);
            
            // Step 6: Log transaction (template method handles this)
            logTransaction(context, transactionId, true, processing.getMetadata());
            
            // Step 7: Send notifications (hook method - can be overridden)
            sendNotification(context, transactionId, true);
            
            long processingTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
            Map<String, Object> metadata = new HashMap<>(processing.getMetadata());
            metadata.put("processingTimeMs", processingTime);
            metadata.put("processor", this.getClass().getSimpleName());
            
            return new PaymentResult(true, "Payment processed successfully", 
                                   transactionId, context.getAmount(), metadata);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            logger.log(Level.SEVERE, "Payment processing failed for " + context.getPaymentId(), e);
            
            // Ensure logging and notification even in case of exceptions
            logTransaction(context, transactionId, false, 
                         Map.of("error", e.getMessage(), "errorType", e.getClass().getSimpleName()));
            sendNotification(context, transactionId, false);
            
            return createFailureResult(transactionId, context.getAmount(), 
                                     "Processing error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    // Abstract methods that subclasses MUST implement
    
    /**
     * Validate the payment context
     * Each payment method has different validation rules
     */
    protected abstract ValidationResult validatePayment(PaymentContext context);
    
    /**
     * Authenticate the payment
     * Each payment method has different authentication mechanisms
     */
    protected abstract AuthenticationResult authenticatePayment(PaymentContext context);
    
    /**
     * Execute the actual payment processing
     * This is where the core payment logic happens
     */
    protected abstract ProcessingResult executePayment(PaymentContext context, String transactionId);
    
    // Hook methods that subclasses CAN override (but don't have to)
    
    /**
     * Pre-processing hook - called before payment execution
     * Subclasses can override to add custom pre-processing logic
     */
    protected void preProcessPayment(PaymentContext context) {
        // Default implementation does nothing
        logger.fine("Pre-processing payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
    }
    
    /**
     * Post-processing hook - called after successful payment execution
     * Subclasses can override to add custom post-processing logic
     */
    protected void postProcessPayment(PaymentContext context, ProcessingResult result) {
        // Default implementation does nothing
        logger.fine("Post-processing payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
    }
    
    /**
     * Notification hook - subclasses can customize notification behavior
     */
    protected void sendNotification(PaymentContext context, String transactionId, boolean success) {
        String message = String.format("Payment %s for %s %s: Transaction ID %s", 
                                      context.getPaymentId(), 
                                      context.getAmount(), 
                                      context.getCurrency(),
                                      success ? "succeeded" : "failed", 
                                      transactionId);
        logger.info("Notification: " + message);
        
        // In a real system, this would send emails, SMS, push notifications, etc.
        NotificationService.getInstance().sendNotification(context.getCustomerInfo(), message);
    }
    
    // Template method helper methods (final - cannot be overridden)
    
    private final String generateTransactionId() {
        return String.format("TXN_%s_%d", 
                           LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMddHHmmss")),
                           transactionCounter.getAndIncrement());
    }
    
    private final void logTransaction(PaymentContext context, String transactionId, 
                                    boolean success, Map<String, Object> metadata) {
        TransactionLog log = new TransactionLog(
            transactionId,
            context.getPaymentId(),
            context.getAmount(),
            context.getCurrency(),
            this.getClass().getSimpleName(),
            success,
            metadata
        );
        
        TransactionLogger.getInstance().log(log);
        
        logger.info(String.format("Transaction logged: %s - %s", transactionId, 
                                success ? "SUCCESS" : "FAILURE"));
    }
    
    private final PaymentResult createFailureResult(String transactionId, BigDecimal amount, String message) {
        return new PaymentResult(false, message, transactionId, amount, 
                               Map.of("processor", this.getClass().getSimpleName()));
    }
    
    // Abstract method to get processor name (for logging and identification)
    public abstract String getProcessorName();
    
    // Abstract method to get supported currencies
    public abstract Set<String> getSupportedCurrencies();
    
    // Abstract method to get processing fees
    public abstract BigDecimal calculateProcessingFee(BigDecimal amount);
}

/**
 * Validation result class
 */
public class ValidationResult {
    private final boolean valid;
    private final String errorMessage;
    private final Map<String, Object> validationData;
    
    public ValidationResult(boolean valid, String errorMessage, Map<String, Object> validationData) {
        this.valid = valid;
        this.errorMessage = errorMessage;
        this.validationData = validationData != null ? new HashMap<>(validationData) : new HashMap<>();
    }
    
    public static ValidationResult success() {
        return new ValidationResult(true, null, null);
    }
    
    public static ValidationResult failure(String errorMessage) {
        return new ValidationResult(false, errorMessage, null);
    }
    
    public boolean isValid() { return valid; }
    public String getErrorMessage() { return errorMessage; }
    public Map<String, Object> getValidationData() { return new HashMap<>(validationData); }
}

/**
 * Authentication result class
 */
public class AuthenticationResult {
    private final boolean authenticated;
    private final String errorMessage;
    private final Map<String, Object> authData;
    
    public AuthenticationResult(boolean authenticated, String errorMessage, Map<String, Object> authData) {
        this.authenticated = authenticated;
        this.errorMessage = errorMessage;
        this.authData = authData != null ? new HashMap<>(authData) : new HashMap<>();
    }
    
    public static AuthenticationResult success(Map<String, Object> authData) {
        return new AuthenticationResult(true, null, authData);
    }
    
    public static AuthenticationResult failure(String errorMessage) {
        return new AuthenticationResult(false, errorMessage, null);
    }
    
    public boolean isAuthenticated() { return authenticated; }
    public String getErrorMessage() { return errorMessage; }
    public Map<String, Object> getAuthData() { return new HashMap<>(authData); }
}

/**
 * Processing result class
 */
public class ProcessingResult {
    private final boolean successful;
    private final String errorMessage;
    private final Map<String, Object> metadata;
    
    public ProcessingResult(boolean successful, String errorMessage, Map<String, Object> metadata) {
        this.successful = successful;
        this.errorMessage = errorMessage;
        this.metadata = metadata != null ? new HashMap<>(metadata) : new HashMap<>();
    }
    
    public static ProcessingResult success(Map<String, Object> metadata) {
        return new ProcessingResult(true, null, metadata);
    }
    
    public static ProcessingResult failure(String errorMessage) {
        return new ProcessingResult(false, errorMessage, null);
    }
    
    public boolean isSuccessful() { return successful; }
    public String getErrorMessage() { return errorMessage; }
    public Map<String, Object> getMetadata() { return new HashMap<>(metadata); }
}

/**
 * Concrete implementation: Credit Card Payment Processor
 */
public class CreditCardProcessor extends PaymentProcessor {
    
    private static final Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(CreditCardProcessor.class.getName());
    private static final Set<String> SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES = Set.of("USD", "EUR", "GBP", "CAD");
    private static final BigDecimal PROCESSING_FEE_RATE = new BigDecimal("0.029"); // 2.9%
    
    @Override
    protected ValidationResult validatePayment(PaymentContext context) {
        logger.fine("Validating credit card payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        // Validate amount
        if (context.getAmount().compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Amount must be positive");
        }
        
        if (context.getAmount().compareTo(new BigDecimal("10000")) > 0) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Amount exceeds maximum limit of $10,000");
        }
        
        // Validate currency
        if (!SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.contains(context.getCurrency())) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Unsupported currency: " + context.getCurrency());
        }
        
        // Validate card number
        String cardNumber = context.getAdditionalData("cardNumber", String.class);
        if (cardNumber == null || cardNumber.length() < 13 || cardNumber.length() > 19) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Invalid card number format");
        }
        
        // Validate expiry date
        String expiryDate = context.getAdditionalData("expiryDate", String.class);
        if (expiryDate == null || !expiryDate.matches("\\d{2}/\\d{2}")) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Invalid expiry date format (MM/YY expected)");
        }
        
        // Validate CVV
        String cvv = context.getAdditionalData("cvv", String.class);
        if (cvv == null || !cvv.matches("\\d{3,4}")) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Invalid CVV format");
        }
        
        Map<String, Object> validationData = Map.of(
            "cardType", detectCardType(cardNumber),
            "maskedCardNumber", maskCardNumber(cardNumber)
        );
        
        return new ValidationResult(true, null, validationData);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected AuthenticationResult authenticatePayment(PaymentContext context) {
        logger.fine("Authenticating credit card payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        String cardNumber = context.getAdditionalData("cardNumber", String.class);
        String cvv = context.getAdditionalData("cvv", String.class);
        String expiryDate = context.getAdditionalData("expiryDate", String.class);
        
        // Simulate authentication with payment gateway
        try {
            Thread.sleep(100); // Simulate network call
            
            // In a real system, this would call the payment gateway API
            boolean authResult = authenticateWithGateway(cardNumber, cvv, expiryDate);
            
            if (authResult) {
                Map<String, Object> authData = Map.of(
                    "gatewayResponse", "APPROVED",
                    "authCode", generateAuthCode(),
                    "cardType", detectCardType(cardNumber)
                );
                return AuthenticationResult.success(authData);
            } else {
                return AuthenticationResult.failure("Card authentication failed");
            }
            
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return AuthenticationResult.failure("Authentication timeout");
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    protected ProcessingResult executePayment(PaymentContext context, String transactionId) {
        logger.info("Executing credit card payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        String cardNumber = context.getAdditionalData("cardNumber", String.class);
        BigDecimal amount = context.getAmount();
        
        try {
            // Simulate payment processing
            Thread.sleep(200); // Simulate processing time
            
            // In a real system, this would charge the card through the payment gateway
            boolean chargeResult = chargeCard(cardNumber, amount, transactionId);
            
            if (chargeResult) {
                BigDecimal processingFee = calculateProcessingFee(amount);
                Map<String, Object> metadata = Map.of(
                    "gatewayTransactionId", "GTW_" + transactionId,
                    "processingFee", processingFee,
                    "netAmount", amount.subtract(processingFee),
                    "cardType", detectCardType(cardNumber),
                    "maskedCardNumber", maskCardNumber(cardNumber)
                );
                return ProcessingResult.success(metadata);
            } else {
                return ProcessingResult.failure("Card charge failed");
            }
            
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return ProcessingResult.failure("Processing timeout");
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void preProcessPayment(PaymentContext context) {
        super.preProcessPayment(context);
        
        // Credit card specific pre-processing
        String cardNumber = context.getAdditionalData("cardNumber", String.class);
        logger.info("Pre-processing credit card payment for card ending in " + 
                   cardNumber.substring(cardNumber.length() - 4));
        
        // Could add fraud detection, risk assessment, etc.
        performFraudCheck(context);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void postProcessPayment(PaymentContext context, ProcessingResult result) {
        super.postProcessPayment(context, result);
        
        // Credit card specific post-processing
        logger.info("Post-processing credit card payment - updating merchant account");
        
        // Could update merchant account balance, send receipts, etc.
        updateMerchantAccount(context, result);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void sendNotification(PaymentContext context, String transactionId, boolean success) {
        // Custom notification for credit card payments
        String cardNumber = context.getAdditionalData("cardNumber", String.class);
        String maskedCard = maskCardNumber(cardNumber);
        
        String message = String.format("Credit Card Payment %s: %s %s charged to card %s (Transaction: %s)",
                                      success ? "Successful" : "Failed",
                                      context.getAmount(),
                                      context.getCurrency(),
                                      maskedCard,
                                      transactionId);
        
        logger.info("Credit Card Notification: " + message);
        NotificationService.getInstance().sendNotification(context.getCustomerInfo(), message);
        
        // Send email receipt for successful payments
        if (success) {
            EmailService.getInstance().sendReceipt(context.getCustomerInfo(), transactionId, context);
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    public String getProcessorName() {
        return "Credit Card Processor";
    }
    
    @Override
    public Set<String> getSupportedCurrencies() {
        return new HashSet<>(SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES);
    }
    
    @Override
    public BigDecimal calculateProcessingFee(BigDecimal amount) {
        return amount.multiply(PROCESSING_FEE_RATE).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
    
    // Helper methods specific to credit card processing
    
    private boolean authenticateWithGateway(String cardNumber, String cvv, String expiryDate) {
        // Simulate gateway authentication
        // In reality, this would make an API call to Stripe, Square, etc.
        return !cardNumber.endsWith("0000"); // Simulate some cards failing
    }
    
    private boolean chargeCard(String cardNumber, BigDecimal amount, String transactionId) {
        // Simulate card charging
        // In reality, this would make an API call to the payment gateway
        return Math.random() > 0.05; // 95% success rate simulation
    }
    
    private String detectCardType(String cardNumber) {
        if (cardNumber.startsWith("4")) return "VISA";
        if (cardNumber.startsWith("5")) return "MASTERCARD";
        if (cardNumber.startsWith("3")) return "AMEX";
        return "UNKNOWN";
    }
    
    private String maskCardNumber(String cardNumber) {
        if (cardNumber.length() < 4) return "****";
        return "**** **** **** " + cardNumber.substring(cardNumber.length() - 4);
    }
    
    private String generateAuthCode() {
        return "AUTH_" + System.currentTimeMillis() % 1000000;
    }
    
    private void performFraudCheck(PaymentContext context) {
        // Simulate fraud detection
        logger.fine("Performing fraud check for payment " + context.getPaymentId());
    }
    
    private void updateMerchantAccount(PaymentContext context, ProcessingResult result) {
        // Simulate merchant account update
        logger.fine("Updating merchant account for payment " + context.getPaymentId());
    }
}

/**
 * Concrete implementation: PayPal Payment Processor
 */
public class PayPalProcessor extends PaymentProcessor {
    
    private static final Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(PayPalProcessor.class.getName());
    private static final Set<String> SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES = Set.of("USD", "EUR", "GBP", "CAD", "AUD", "JPY");
    private static final BigDecimal PROCESSING_FEE_RATE = new BigDecimal("0.034"); // 3.4%
    
    @Override
    protected ValidationResult validatePayment(PaymentContext context) {
        logger.fine("Validating PayPal payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        // Validate amount
        if (context.getAmount().compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Amount must be positive");
        }
        
        if (context.getAmount().compareTo(new BigDecimal("25000")) > 0) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Amount exceeds maximum limit of $25,000");
        }
        
        // Validate currency
        if (!SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.contains(context.getCurrency())) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Unsupported currency: " + context.getCurrency());
        }
        
        // Validate PayPal email
        String paypalEmail = context.getAdditionalData("paypalEmail", String.class);
        if (paypalEmail == null || !paypalEmail.matches("^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@(.+)$")) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Invalid PayPal email format");
        }
        
        Map<String, Object> validationData = Map.of(
            "paypalEmail", paypalEmail,
            "accountType", "PERSONAL" // Could be determined by API call
        );
        
        return new ValidationResult(true, null, validationData);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected AuthenticationResult authenticatePayment(PaymentContext context) {
        logger.fine("Authenticating PayPal payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        String paypalEmail = context.getAdditionalData("paypalEmail", String.class);
        
        try {
            Thread.sleep(150); // Simulate PayPal API call
            
            // In a real system, this would authenticate with PayPal API
            boolean authResult = authenticateWithPayPal(paypalEmail);
            
            if (authResult) {
                Map<String, Object> authData = Map.of(
                    "paypalResponse", "VERIFIED",
                    "payerId", generatePayerId(),
                    "accountStatus", "VERIFIED"
                );
                return AuthenticationResult.success(authData);
            } else {
                return AuthenticationResult.failure("PayPal account authentication failed");
            }
            
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return AuthenticationResult.failure("PayPal authentication timeout");
        }
    }
    
    @Override

        logger.info("Executing PayPal payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        String paypalEmail = context.getAdditionalData("paypalEmail", String.class);
        BigDecimal amount = context.getAmount();
        
        try {
            // Simulate PayPal payment processing
            Thread.sleep(300); // PayPal typically takes longer
            
            // In a real system, this would process payment through PayPal API
            boolean paymentResult = processPayPalPayment(paypalEmail, amount, transactionId);
            
            if (paymentResult) {
                BigDecimal processingFee = calculateProcessingFee(amount);
                Map<String, Object> metadata = Map.of(
                    "paypalTransactionId", "PP_" + transactionId,
                    "processingFee", processingFee,
                    "netAmount", amount.subtract(processingFee),
                    "paypalEmail", paypalEmail,
                    "paymentMethod", "PAYPAL_BALANCE" // Could be BANK, CARD, etc.
                );
                return ProcessingResult.success(metadata);
            } else {
                return ProcessingResult.failure("PayPal payment processing failed");
            }
            
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return ProcessingResult.failure("PayPal processing timeout");
        }
    }

        // PayPal specific pre-processing
        String paypalEmail = context.getAdditionalData("paypalEmail", String.class);

        // Could check PayPal account limits, verify account status, etc.

/**
 * Concrete implementation: Bank Transfer Processor
 */
public class BankTransferProcessor extends PaymentProcessor {
    
    private static final Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(BankTransferProcessor.class.getName());
    private static final Set<String> SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES = Set.of("USD", "EUR", "GBP");
    private static final BigDecimal PROCESSING_FEE_FLAT = new BigDecimal("5.00"); // Flat fee
    
    @Override
    protected ValidationResult validatePayment(PaymentContext context) {
        logger.fine("Validating bank transfer payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        // Validate amount (bank transfers typically have higher minimums)
        if (context.getAmount().compareTo(new BigDecimal("10")) < 0) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Minimum amount for bank transfer is $10");
        }
        
        if (context.getAmount().compareTo(new BigDecimal("100000")) > 0) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Amount exceeds maximum limit of $100,000");
        }
        
        // Validate currency
        if (!SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.contains(context.getCurrency())) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Unsupported currency: " + context.getCurrency());
        }
        
        // Validate bank account details
        String accountNumber = context.getAdditionalData("accountNumber", String.class);
        String routingNumber = context.getAdditionalData("routingNumber", String.class);
        String accountType = context.getAdditionalData("accountType", String.class);
        
        if (accountNumber == null || accountNumber.length() < 8) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Invalid account number");
        }
        
        if (routingNumber == null || !routingNumber.matches("\\d{9}")) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Invalid routing number (9 digits required)");
        }
        
        if (accountType == null || (!accountType.equals("CHECKING") && !accountType.equals("SAVINGS"))) {
            return ValidationResult.failure("Account type must be CHECKING or SAVINGS");
        }
        
        Map<String, Object> validationData = Map.of(
            "accountType", accountType,
            "maskedAccountNumber", maskAccountNumber(accountNumber),
            "bankName", getBankName(routingNumber)
        );
        
        return new ValidationResult(true, null, validationData);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected AuthenticationResult authenticatePayment(PaymentContext context) {
        logger.fine("Authenticating bank transfer payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        String accountNumber = context.getAdditionalData("accountNumber", String.class);
        String routingNumber = context.getAdditionalData("routingNumber", String.class);
        
        try {
            Thread.sleep(500); // Bank verification takes longer
            
            // In a real system, this would verify account with bank API or ACH network
            boolean authResult = verifyBankAccount(accountNumber, routingNumber);
            
            if (authResult) {
                Map<String, Object> authData = Map.of(

                    "achEligible", true,
                    "bankName", getBankName(routingNumber)
                );
                return AuthenticationResult.success(authData);
            } else {

            }
            
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return AuthenticationResult.failure("Bank verification timeout");
        }
    }
    
    @Override

        logger.info("Executing bank transfer payment for " + context.getPaymentId());
        
        String accountNumber = context.getAdditionalData("accountNumber", String.class);
        String routingNumber = context.getAdditionalData("routingNumber", String.class);
        BigDecimal amount = context.getAmount();
        
        try {
            // Simulate ACH processing (takes longer than card payments)
            Thread.sleep(1000);
            
            // In a real system, this would initiate ACH transfer
            boolean transferResult = initiateACHTransfer(accountNumber, routingNumber, amount, transactionId);
            
            if (transferResult) {
                BigDecimal processingFee = calculateProcessingFee(amount);
                Map<String, Object> metadata = Map.of(
                    "achTransactionId", "ACH_" + transactionId,
                    "processingFee", processingFee,
                    "netAmount", amount.subtract(processingFee),
                    "maskedAccountNumber", maskAccountNumber(accountNumber),
                    "bankName", getBankName(routingNumber),
                    "settlementDate", LocalDateTime.now().plusDays(3).toString() // ACH takes 3 business days
                );
                return ProcessingResult.success(metadata);
            } else {
                return ProcessingResult.failure("ACH transfer initiation failed");
            }
            
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return ProcessingResult.failure("ACH processing timeout");
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void preProcessPayment(PaymentContext context) {
        super.preProcessPayment(context);
        
        // Bank transfer specific pre-processing
        logger.info("Pre-processing bank transfer - checking business hours and settlement times");
        
        // Could check if it's a business day, banking hours, etc.
        checkBankingHours(context);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void postProcessPayment(PaymentContext context, ProcessingResult result) {
        super.postProcessPayment(context, result);
        
        // Bank transfer specific post-processing
        logger.info("Post-processing bank transfer - scheduling settlement monitoring");
        
        // Could schedule settlement monitoring, compliance checks, etc.
        scheduleSettlementMonitoring(context, result);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void sendNotification(PaymentContext context, String transactionId, boolean success) {
        // Custom notification for bank transfers
        String accountNumber = context.getAdditionalData("accountNumber", String.class);
        String maskedAccount = maskAccountNumber(accountNumber);
        
        String message = String.format("Bank Transfer %s: %s %s %s account %s (Transaction: %s)%s",
                                      success ? "Initiated" : "Failed",
                                      context.getAmount(),
                                      context.getCurrency(),
                                      success ? "will be transferred from" : "could not be transferred from",
                                      maskedAccount,
                                      transactionId,
                                      success ? " - Settlement in 3 business days" : "");
        
        logger.info("Bank Transfer Notification: " + message);
        NotificationService.getInstance().sendNotification(context.getCustomerInfo(), message);
        
        // Send bank-specific notifications
        if (success) {
            BankNotificationService.getInstance().sendTransferConfirmation(
                context.getCustomerInfo(), transactionId, context);
        }
    }
    
    @Override

        return "Bank Transfer Processor";
    }
    
    @Override
    public Set<String> getSupportedCurrencies() {
        return new HashSet<>(SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES);
    }
    
    @Override

        return PROCESSING_FEE_FLAT; // Flat fee for bank transfers
    }
    
    // Helper methods specific to bank transfer processing
    
    private boolean verifyBankAccount(String accountNumber, String routingNumber) {
        // Simulate bank account verification
        return !accountNumber.endsWith("0000");
    }
    
    private boolean initiateACHTransfer(String accountNumber, String routingNumber, 
                                      BigDecimal amount, String transactionId) {
        // Simulate ACH transfer initiation
        return Math.random() > 0.02; // 98% success rate

    private String maskAccountNumber(String accountNumber) {
        if (accountNumber.length() < 4) return "****";
        return "****" + accountNumber.substring(accountNumber.length() - 4);
    }
    
    private String getBankName(String routingNumber) {

            "026009593", "Bank of America",
            "121000248", "Wells Fargo",
            "111000025", "Federal Reserve Bank"
        );
        return bankNames.getOrDefault(routingNumber, "Unknown Bank");
    }
    
    private void checkBankingHours(PaymentContext context) {
        logger.fine("Checking banking hours for payment " + context.getPaymentId());
    }
    
    private void scheduleSettlementMonitoring(PaymentContext context, ProcessingResult result) {
        logger.fine("Scheduling settlement monitoring for payment " + context.getPaymentId());
    }
```
